title: C0: paired D3 N7M6 minus D4 s5 contrast from retained per-game records
hypothesis: On the retained drop7-lifetime-cohort-v1 per-game records for D3 N7M6 (runs/RUN-A525-reveal/d3-n7-m6.json) and D4 s5 (runs/RUN-A51D-s7confirm/fresh-s5.json), both covering seeds 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f, the paired score delta has a one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound and a Student-t lower bound both above zero.

comparator.name: D4 s5: parameterized-fair-search, depth 4, chanceSamples 5 (N5 M1), terminalUtility -1000000, maximumWork 3200000, 2000-move cap, corrected 17,000-point Hardcore scoring (finding-05 fresh-s5 arm, runs/RUN-A51D-s7confirm/fresh-s5.json; byte-identical games to runs/RUN-A52-LEAF/eval/s5-w000.json)

datasetRefs: runs/RUN-A51D-s7confirm/fresh-s7.json (sha256 0c95442620a78ef5a928a4b8cdab9f57b3bdb8a3d7df5fcd1a6d818785bd4209; secondary D4 s7 contrast only)
data.reuseDisclosure: Reanalysis only: no game is played, no seed is opened, no lease is consumed. Both arms were played under SEEDLEASE-A51D on the already-read shared development cohort 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f (exploratory-development-diagnostic). The arm MEANS (376,442 and 297,327) and their difference (+79,115) were published in finding-16 and finding-05 and were known to the author before this gate was written, as was the finding-16 contrast D3 N7M6 minus D4 N7 M1 (-22,056). What was never computed or printed is the paired per-game D3 N7M6 minus D4 s5 delta and its bounds. This is therefore a bound computation on already-read data whose sign is already known; it is diagnostic tier only and its pass cannot be promoted above public-development on this cohort. The bootstrap seed, resample count and analysis code are pinned in expectedArtifacts before the wrapper is run.

metrics.primary: paired mean whole-game score delta, D3 N7M6 minus D4 s5, 64 games, seeds 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f
secondary: first-half / second-half deltas in seed order (seeds 0xa51d1000-0xa51d101f and 0xa51d1020-0xa51d103f)
Q25 delta (marginal), median, min, max per arm
paired numbered clears and cover reveals deltas
the same contrast D3 N7M6 minus D4 s7 (fresh-s7.json), reported as a diagnostic, not gated
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: one-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over whole games (20,000 resamples, numpy PCG64 seed 0xB0071EAF, via the paired() function of approaches/lifetime-objective/chain-reveal-leaf/compare.py imported unchanged by the c0_compare.py wrapper) and Student-t one-sided 95% lower bound; detection floor reported

passCriteria: Both arms are drop7-lifetime-cohort-v1 artifacts covering exactly the same 64 seeds 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f in order, 0 censored games, 2000-move cap, terminalUtility -1000000, seedLease SEEDLEASE-A51D.
D3 N7M6 minus D4 s5 paired score delta: percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 AND Student-t 95% lower bound > 0.
gate.failureAction: Record valid + fail; the theory is not-supported-as-tested at public-development tier; the +79,115 difference of means may not be quoted as a head start in the K2 program without the bound attached; open no cohort.
gate.passAction: Record valid + pass at public-development tier on already-read data; no tier above CHECK/diagnostic is claimed because the point estimate preceded the gate; any promotion requires a fresh-development cohort under a new protocol.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop and record nothing beyond c0.md if the seed lists of the two arms differ or either artifact is not drop7-lifetime-cohort-v1.
